acceptanceCriteria.description: Exactly one adult hero; no duplicated body or anatomy.
Full head, both hands, and both feet are visible with safe margin.
Cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing, visibly painterly and not photographic or cel-anime.
Body, height, age, skin, hair, clothing, palette, and detail manifest remain legible.
Calm neutral expression without smile, grin, or theatrical acting.
Ordinary mortal presentation with no weapon, magic, affinity cue, elite armor, frame, star, UI, or text.
Does not reproduce a declared style reference's face, body, hair, or outfit.

canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Adon Quoreth: 29-year-old man, 160 cm (short), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: round full face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: violet-plum-pink, asymmetric-extreme, deliberate accent: segmented wrapped crest. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make body construction and habitual posture the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.

RESERVE ACTIVATION: This is a fresh base summon, not an edit or regeneration of any existing hero. Create the new identity described above using only the authorized rendering-style reference. Honor the complete activated physical manifest and reserve character kernel; no failed hero or failed candidate is a visual source.
